Name: Werewolf Meteorite
Author: Smapifan
Description:
What the mod does: 

This mod automatically changes the appearance between 7 pm and 8 pm tomorrow or you can activate "Always Werewolf" and the meteorite will always be Werewolf. 

---

Installation on Pc: 

1. Download the mod 
2. unpack the zip in the mod folder.
3. Start the game  

---

Installation on Android:

1. Download the mod 
2. Open the Smapi Loader
3. Go to Mod Manager 
4. click "Install Mod" 
5.select the mod zip
6. Start the game
